llm.summary: MeshMorize is a disclosed local memory/logging helper with no bundled executable code, network behavior, credential handling, or hidden persistence found.

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes a multi-layer memory system for agent notes, graph relationships, fuzzy search, and compliance checks; local logging and memory search fit that stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill documents commands that log interactions and search memory, including complete interaction history; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should understand conversations may be stored locally.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only a single SKILL.md markdown file, with no executable scripts, declared dependencies, install hooks, or bundled runtime payload.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The documented storage is under memory paths and references OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE support, which is proportionate for a workspace memory helper.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates persistent memory/log files, but the artifact does not show privilege escalation, background services, credential/session access, destructive actions, or external data transfer.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent memory layer that may retain interaction history in local workspace files. Avoid logging secrets or sensitive personal data unless you are comfortable storing it there, and periodically review or delete the memory files if retention matters.
